notes: Prompts are assembled as art plan 2.3: the composition clause with {KEY} replaced, 'Subject: <subject>.', the style formula, the avoid clause, joined by blank lines. image_references are style.references[composition] then extraRefs (at most 4). 'turnaround:concept_<look>' means the picked T3 job of that item. Raw generations are never committed; each is found by its job id. T4 deviation (DECISIONS A63): the room reference is left out, because flux_3_image copied the mixer room into the backdrop of the first baker portraits; world-look portraits use the two style.json portrait figures and the picked turnaround, covers the two figures. The baker's first pair kept the mixer room (its pick fits the bakery). Two cover retries re-state the subject per art plan 2.3 ('retrySubject'). Total: 20 T3 + 16 T4 = 36 images, 108 credits.
